fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on hurricane disaster relief and criticism of the American National Red Cross response (with references to the Palm Beach/Belle Glade area and prior Miami hurricane experience), local politics and governance (including Hialeah city finances and the Florida Inland Navigation District bond issue), and a rebuttal to accusations that the paper accepted gambling “protection” money. Additional pieces cover liquor/rum-running conditions and prices after storms in the Bahamas, notes on theaters and entertainment (including discussion of Vitaphone), and recurring humor and society-style local items and advertisements.
